results.content: # Intergenerational Mobility in Latin America: The Multiple Facets of Social Status and the Role of Mothers. In this paper we assess intergenerational mobility in terms of education and income rank in five Latin American countries—Brazil, Chile, Ecuador, Mexico, and Panama—by accounting for the education and occupation of both parents.
